lessons_used: Predictions remained biased: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) performed worse in 2 out of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded inconsistent results, each driving significant wins (+4.9% to +6.7%) alongside clear losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as choose_path layout, finish layout, and single-test changes).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection step into a compact grid layout to reduce scrolling and friction during pet adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 23.4% with a median duration of 89s, indicating users spend significant effort comparing options.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend layout to compact grid while keeping the pet selection function intact inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns show mild positive average (+0.7% across 5 tests) but high variance.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Accessories Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add a pet accessory selection step right after picking a pet to increase emotional attachment before final adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a median 89s and support emails indicate high user demand for pet customization options.

guard.reason: Adds a valid customization step inside onboarding without removing any required steps or violating pricing rules.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from support emails, but adding new flows historically causes heavy drop-off (-13.4%).

candidates.title: Sign In Split Screen Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing animated pet companions alongside authentication options.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 79.7% with a mean duration of 567s, reflecting user hesitation during authentication.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen to a split layout while maintaining the sign-in job.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in redesigns previously showed a negative result (-3.8%).

candidates.title: Companion Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Insert a personality quiz screen prior to choose_path to help guide users to their preferred companion type.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s with 13.8% drop-off; guiding decision-making reduces choice paralysis.

guard.reason: Inserts a personality quiz screen inside onboarding without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens consistently hurts conversion across previous tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Card Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story intro screen into an interactive card carousel showcasing desktop pet features.
candidates.why: Story and path selection average 514s mean time, demonstrating a need for engaging introductory visual structure.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen to a carousel layout while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesign had a positive single test (+7.6%), though evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: Sign In Quick Passwordless Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear hint highlighting fast passwordless magic link sign-in directly on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: Sign-in has a mean time of 567s and 8 support tickets were filed regarding sign-in and account access issues.

sign_in.hint: Use your email for instant magic link login. No password required.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Home Intro Full Bleed Layout
candidates.change: Change the final home intro layout to a full bleed presentation showcasing the desktop pet arrival.
candidates.why: Finish stage has the lowest funnel conversion at 68.0% and a high mean completion time.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro layout to full bleed, which is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 32% of users; layout changes showed positive early test (+6.6%).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward
candidates.change: Add a prominent companion owner milestone badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 23.4%; offering positive reinforcement upon adoption boosts transition to waiting screen.

guard.reason: Adds a guardian badge component to the adoption certificate screen without removing required elements or violating copy rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at adoption drop-off, but incentive changes are unmeasured so far.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desk Docking Visual
candidates.change: Add an animation component to the waiting screen illustrating how the pet docks on the user's desktop screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how or where the pet appears on their desktop display.

guard.reason: Adds a docking preview animation component to the waiting screen as allowed onboarding waiting-screen information.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails, but wait_info changes have shown no clear effect across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint
candidates.change: Add a explicit hint on the final home intro screen explaining system tray controls for managing the pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to control, hide, or chat with the pet.

home_intro.hint: Click the system tray icon anytime to minimize, customize, or chat with your pet.

guard.reason: Adds system tray controls hint to home_intro within onboarding boundaries.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support emails at the lowest-converting step with simple config/copy hint.

lessons_next: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.2% and -9.2%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) consistently improved performance across 2 agreeing winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+3.3% to +6.8%) and major losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as single-test changes, finish layout, and sign-in redesigns).
